description: Almost nothing in this family is spontaneous. It rests on a long stretch of ordinary, unphotographed effort that becomes visible all at once.
Asked years later what made it good, people name the company rather than the content. The Harvard Study of Adult Development has been producing that result for eighty-seven years.
notes: Harvard Study of Adult Development: relationship quality is the strongest single predictor of health and happiness.

description: Being allowed out until it got dark stops being an event and becomes a reference point - retold, compared against, and eventually shorthand inside one family for a whole kind of day.

notes: Experiential purchases retain value through memory where material ones decay; people are markedly unwilling to trade the memory away.
